result.summary: The page is generally well laid out. One visible content/formatting issue appears in the promotion banner.

issues.description: The promotional banner shows the minimum-order text as “min. order €10”, which is awkwardly formatted and lacks a separator/space before the amount.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer localized format, such as “Min. order: €10” or “Min. order €10,” and ensure consistent spacing and punctuation.
